title: The Quiet American
author: Graham Greene
summary: In 1950s Saigon, the cynical British journalist Fowler befriends idealistic American Alden Pyle, then finds Pyle has taken his lover. Against the backdrop of French colonial war, Fowler learns what Pyle is really doing.
readIf: you like short, morally complex novels about politics and personal betrayal.
skipIf: you want an action-led spy thriller.
